name: whatsapp_send
description: Send a WhatsApp message to a phone number. Opens the chat with the text prefilled through a deep link in the chosen WhatsApp (Personal or Business; it asks when both are installed), confirms the recipient's number and the draft are on screen, then taps Send. The Send tap is an outward step: it only runs with approved=true.

phone.description: Recipient number with country code, digits only (for example 971501234567)

contact.description: Optional but recommended: the contact name exactly as saved. If given, the chat header must show it or the run stops before Send.

app.description: personal or business. If both WhatsApps are installed and this is not given, the run stops with status needs_choice: ask the human which one.

steps.why: WhatsApp may show a chooser sheet first
the chat header must show this number
the chat header must show this saved contact name
the green Send button (calibrated on iPhone 16 Pro, WhatsApp 2026-11)
